llm_summary: Summary: The overall sentiment toward the Murad Nutrient-Charged Water Gel is highly positive, with users frequently praising its lightweight, non-greasy texture and effectiveness for oily or acne-prone skin. While it is widely celebrated for layering well under makeup without clogging pores, the primary consumer complaint is its high price point. Consequently, many reviewers actively seek out more affordable drugstore alternatives that offer similar hydration without the premium cost.
